document.title: Remove the old .githooks setup and keep eval artifacts 7 days
document.summary: Deletes the leftover `.githooks` installer, its test, and a stale comment. Sets `retention-days: 7` on the eval run artifact.
document.why: No pre-commit hook ran because `core.hooksPath` still pointed at the deleted `.githooks` folder, and eval artifacts filled the account's Actions storage quota [as the request says](source:s1).

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 21
sources.gist: Máté asks to make pre-commit hooks run again, remove the old .githooks leftovers, and keep eval artifacts for 7 days.

lookFor: Each existing clone or worktree still needs a one-time local fix: `git config --unset core.hooksPath`, then `vp config --no-agent`. `vp config` skips with exit 0 while `core.hooksPath` holds another value.

commits.subject: Remove leftover .githooks setup and expire eval artifacts after 7 days
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The shared git config still pointed core.hooksPath at the deleted .githooks directory, so `vp config` skipped installing the Vite+ dispatcher and no pre-commit hook ran. The config is fixed locally; this drops the old installer, its test, and the stale mirror comment.

Eval run artifacts used GitHub's 90-day default retention and filled the account's Actions storage quota.
